messages:
tara (Docs): opened a tiny PR to fix a broken link + update an SDK example. blocked by CODEOWNERS because the path glob matched /docs/sdk/ even though it's in /docs/guides
james (Eng): seeing the same. CODEOWNERS glob is over-broad. we should avoid manual owner reviews for trivial docs fixes
ci-bot: checks/run: docs-preview failed 1 Error: frontmatter.validation (page: docs/guides/python-auth.md)
label-bot: note: label 'docs:fast-track' exists but is protected. only members of team docs-maintainers can add it
tara (Docs): proposal: add a lightweight 'fast-track' flow: an automated check confirms (a) only markdown changed, (b) total additions < 30, (c) no /docs/reference or /docs/sdk/reference files touched. if checks pass, post a comment to request a fast-track from a maintainer
james (Eng): agree. we need auditability: who applied the label and why. require the maintainer to comment with a short reason when adding label
ops (Security): caution: do not use pull_request_target on external PRs unless label addition is gated by team membership. else elevated token can be abused
james (Eng): implementation sketch (simpler): use git diff --name-only + --numstat to sum added lines, verify extensions are .md/.mdx, check for forbidden paths, then post comment 'ready for fast-track'
tara (Docs): will draft the action and a tiny policy doc. for this PR can a maintainer add the label so we can re-run preview? aiming to merge during today's docs window (16:00 PST) :clock4:
label-bot: request logged: docs-fast-track-request by tara (Docs) for PR #1512
ci-bot: preview queued after label change...
james (Eng): once preview green i'll ping owners and merge during the window. also filed issue to tighten CODEOWNERS globs to avoid sibling matches
tara (Docs): thanks! I'll include the audit instructions in the RFC so ops can query fast-track events later :memo:
